patch.summary: Is AI InteleKt worth it? AI InteleKt is a customer data and retail intelligence platform — unify POS, web, and mobile touchpoints into Customer 360° profiles; predict churn and CLV; orchestrate loyalty, email/SMS engagement, and AI-assisted sales and service workflows. Demo-led pricin…. Strong when Retail, ecommerce, telecom, or financial services teams unifying customer data. Weak when Confirm integrations for POS, web, and mobile sources.
